title: Ego cannot deliver the peace it promises
summary: This meets the self-willed life that still expects peace as a reward. The line says ego cannot make peace; it only keeps forgetting Naam.
takeaway: Let Naam quench what ego ignites.
lifeApplication: Before insisting on your way one more time, notice the heat in the face and chest. Use the line before self-will turns into another round of inner noise.

source.shortMeaning: Ego cannot make peace; Naam cools what self-will inflames.
source.lifeApplication: When self-will rises, take Naam before trying to win the moment.

evidence.turn: Ego cannot make peace; Naam and service can.
